Advanced Packaging Innovation Laboratory · Hanyang University

Reliability for the next generation of semiconductor packaging

차세대 반도체 패키징의 공정·계측·신뢰성 예측을 연구합니다.

APIL, led by Prof. Hak-Sung Kim in the Department of Mechanical Engineering, develops processes, in-situ metrology and physics-based reliability prediction for advanced semiconductor packaging — from intense-pulsed-light bonding and glass substrates to terahertz inspection and warpage modeling.

Research · 연구 분야

Design, bonding, AI and inspection — across the package.

Four key research areas: package design and reliability, next-generation bonding, AI-based prediction and control, and THz / lock-in thermography inspection.

본 연구실은 첨단 반도체 패키징 설계·신뢰성 평가, 차세대 반도체 본딩 공정 개발, 인공지능 응용 기술, 테라헤르츠파 및 LIT 기반 비파괴 검사 기술을 4대 핵심 연구 분야로 하여, 소재–공정–검사–예측을 아우르는 첨단 패키징 연구를 수행하고 있습니다. 연구실은 다기능성 복합재료 설계 및 제조 연구실(MCDM Lab)에서 출발하여 광소결(IPL)·인쇄전자와 복합재료 연구의 기반 위에, 현재 첨단 반도체 패키징을 중심으로 한 APIL(Advanced Packaging Innovation Laboratory)로 발전하였습니다.

Projects · 연구 과제 — featured

200 Gb/s/λ Tx–Rx co-packaged optics & ultra-fine interconnect: integrated reliability design and verification platform

200 Gb/s/λ급 Tx-Rx 고집적 Co-Packaged Optics·초미세 인터커넥트 고신뢰 통합 설계·검증 플랫폼 구축

A five-year K-CHIPS project in which APIL leads a six-institution consortium. Sending 200 Gb/s per wavelength through a co-packaged optics (CPO) module couples high-power electrical signals, heat, thermo-mechanical deformation and optical alignment, yet no design platform handles these multiphysics together. The project builds one data-, model- and verification-based platform that unites intelligent design, electro-optical co-simulation and ultra-fine, high-reliability interconnects.

CPO에서 200 Gb/s/λ급 신호를 안정적으로 전송하려면 발열, 열·기계적 변형, 광 정렬 손실과 전기 노이즈를 함께 고려한 설계가 필요하지만, 다중물리를 통합한 CPO 설계 플랫폼은 아직 없습니다. 본 과제는 지능형 설계–전기·광 융합 해석–초미세 고신뢰 접합을 통합한 데이터·모델·검증 기반 통합 플랫폼을 구축합니다.

Why a multiphysics platform · 연구 필요성

  • High-power electrical signals along package wiring cause strong self-heating in a CPO package.패키지 배선을 따라 흐르는 고전력 전기 신호가 높은 발열을 유도
  • Heat changes material properties and drives warpage, damage and fracture — and in an alignment-critical CPO it produces severe optical-signal loss.열에 의한 물성 변화·기계적 변형이 극심한 광학 신호 손실을 야기
  • Stable high-speed transmission needs low-noise, high-reliability CPO wiring and interconnects.간섭·노이즈를 최소화하는 고신뢰 전기배선 및 interconnect 설계 필요
  • Photonic design, optical-coupling loss, SI/PI, ultra-fine bonding, packaging reliability and thermo-mechanical-optical co-simulation must therefore be solved together.Multiphysics Simulation + Packaging + Interconnect + AI Design 의 다학제 융합 연구

Three research thrusts · 3개 세부과제

Thrust 1 · 1세부

Integrated simulation & design platform for CPO

CPO 구현을 위한 통합 시뮬레이션 및 설계 플랫폼 개발

  • Thermal error ≤ 10 %, deformation accuracy ≥ 80 % in multiphysics co-simulation
  • Optical coupling loss ≤ 1.5 dB at 1310 nm; drift ≤ 0.5 dB over temperature
  • Alignment tolerance ≥ 2 µm at 1 dB loss; ≥ 10 passive devices

한양대 소홍윤 · 한양대 ERICA 김영현 · KAIST 유경식

Thrust 2 · 2세부

Intelligent design automation for high-density packages

지능형 고집적 반도체 패키지 설계 자동화 기술 확보

  • Thermo-mechanical model covering ≥ 4 failure modes, deformation error ≤ 10 %
  • First opto-electro-mechanical SI/PI framework (power noise ≤ 5 % of supply)
  • ROM/PINN prediction error ≤ 5 %; local-LLM design agent accuracy ≥ 85 %

서울대 류일 · 연세대 이남규 · 세종대 김영우

Thrust 3 · 3세부

Ultra-fine interconnect defect diagnosis & fine-pitch bump bonding

차세대 초미세 인터커넥트 결함 진단 및 Fine pitch 범프 고신뢰 접합 기술 개발

  • Fluxless bonding at bump pitch < 20 µm, shear strength > 10 MPa, void ≤ 5 %, ΔR/R₀ ≤ 10 %
  • AI defect detection ≤ 30 µm (lateral) and ≤ 100 µm (spatial)
  • Micro/nano-mechanical properties of internal structures ≤ 100 nm

한양대 김학성 (APIL) · 서울대 최인석

APIL's role · 세부목표 7

Fluxless fine-pitch bonding and lock-in-thermography defect diagnosis

차세대 초미세 인터커넥트 결함 진단 및 Fine pitch 범프 고신뢰 접합 기술 개발 — 김학성 교수

Reflow and flux-based bonding suffer from alignment error and flux residue. APIL develops UV/plasma fluxless bonding and self-assembled nano-soldering for high-strength interconnects, and phase-locked infrared (lock-in) thermography with deep-learning models for non-destructive, quantitative detection of micro-defects.

  1. Year 1Fluxless and self-assembled nano-solder bonding mechanisms; non-destructive inspection system
  2. Year 2UV/plasma fluxless process · alignment ≤ 20 µm, shear ≥ 3 MPa · detection ≤ 100 µm
  3. Year 3Real-time bond-strength evaluation · ≤ 10 µm, ≥ 6 MPa · AI detection ≤ 70 µm
  4. Year 4Fine-pitch process optimisation · ≤ 8 µm, ≥ 9 MPa · ≤ 50 µm
  5. Year 520 µm-pitch production guideline · ≤ 5 µm, ≥ 12 MPa · ≤ 30 µm lateral / 100 µm spatial
